body:
ItemsRepo.decodeExpense (android/.../data/repo/ItemsRepo.kt:120) decodes the stored expense JSON with Json.Default, which is strict, and returns null on any failure; ExpenseListViewModel then drops the row with mapNotNull. The API client's Json is configured with ignoreUnknownKeys = true (ApiProvider.kt:24), but the expense value is stored as a raw string and decoded later with the default instance.

Today the server strips unknown keys from an expense before storing it, so this cannot happen. The moment a server release adds a key to the expense object, every expense would silently vanish from every Android list until the app is updated, with no error anywhere.

Fix: decode with the lenient instance (inject the API Json, or a shared one with ignoreUnknownKeys), and add a DtoTest/ItemsRepoTest that an expense with an extra key still decodes.
title: Android decodes stored expenses with strict Json.Default; one new server key would hide every expense
